title: Warm Spicy German Chicken Noodles
description: A citrusy and aerated German dish featuring gochugaru and ferment-jang, perfect for a sick day, and sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the egg noodles to the pot and cook according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the gochugaru, ferment-jang, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Drain the noodles and add them to the skillet with the chicken.
Toss the noodles and chicken together, until the noodles are well coated.
